{{Quote|I'll do it. It's crazy, but still, it can't be worse than Mos Eisley Cantina on a Saturday night.|A [[spacer]] to [[Diax]]|<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Saturday''' was a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="Friends Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery|quote=Inside the saloon (right next to the Gotal that narrowly misses getting hit by a flying ax) is a poster advertising that Sebulba will be signing autographs "On Saturday at 10 am."}} {{C|Slide 8}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] performed a [[The Sy Snootles Show|series of concerts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], "[[Friday/Legends|Fri]] — Sat 12 - 4," according to [[The Sy Snootles Show (poster)|posters]] promoting her.<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>
